snippet.title: Deepening Fire - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Here! Deepening Fire is now available on Steam!
Deepening Fire is a horizontal scrolling action game where you will challenge powerful enemies in a lost kingdom. 
You can choose the handiest weapon, put on the most adaptable armor, and use your skill to kill every enemy with precision.

WISHLIST & FOLLOW FOR UPDATES!
